overall_reason: The cookie dialog, the FAQ accordion and the labelled product preview are finished components, but on a phone an 'Install Consile' sheet covers the hero's Start free button on load, and the hero offers three ways in (Start free, Explore the live demo, Book a demo).

score.reason: T-OVERLAY-CHECK passes on the cookie dialog (scrim, close button, closed after Escape) and T-STATE-MATRIX finds a full declared state set, but T-INTERRUPT fails at 375 (CMP-014) and T-PRIMARY-COUNT finds three hero actions (CMP-004).

visitor_mode: Persuade: a SaaS landing page for a team workspace whose goal is a free sign-up or a demo booking. No 00-contract.md; inferred from 'Start free' and 'Book a demo' in the header and hero.

findings.title: Nothing interrupts the visitor uninvited
findings.where: 'Install Consile' sheet, bottom of the first screen, 375, fold-375.png
findings.evidence: At 375 a white sheet 'Install Consile — Open your browser menu, then tap Add to Home Screen or Install app to keep Consile one tap away' with 'Maybe later' and a close button covers the bottom 150px of the first screen on load, cutting through the orange 'Start free' button and hiding 'Explore the live demo' below it.
findings.before: An install prompt opens on a first visit to the marketing page, over the main action.
findings.after: No install prompt on the landing page; offer 'Install app' inside the product after sign-in, when the visitor reaches a feature that needs it (CMP-220).
findings.why: A first-time phone visitor is asked to install an app they have not tried, and the prompt hides the button that would let them try it.

findings.title: One primary action per view
findings.evidence: The hero carries a filled orange 'Start free', a grey filled 'Explore the live demo' (rgba(29, 33, 43, 0.06)) and a text line 'Book a demo with our team instead, or see how it works'; the header repeats 'Login', an outlined 'Book a demo' and a filled 'Start free'. The first screen offers five actions in two rows.
findings.before: Three hero actions and a second set in the header.
findings.after: Start free as the one filled primary, one quieter secondary (the live demo), and Book a demo left to the header.
findings.why: Five ways in on the first screen spread the visitor's choice; the second grey button weighs nearly as much as the primary.

findings.title: The phone gets the whole navigation
findings.evidence: phone_nav records the 375 header as the logo plus one 'Open navigation menu' button 32x32 drawn as a bare three-line icon; Login, Book a demo and Start free all move behind it. The targets sweep flags the 32x32 button.
findings.before: Every destination and both header actions sit behind a small unlabelled icon.
findings.after: 'Start free' kept in the 375 header beside a 'Menu' button with a visible word and a 44px box.
findings.why: On a phone the sign-up action leaves the header, and the only route to Pricing is a 32px icon.

findings.title: Every navigation item and action goes somewhere
findings.where: footer column heads 'PRODUCT', 'WHO IT'S FOR', 'LEGAL', 'COMPANY', 'FREE TOOLS', 1440, motion/t3-normal-600.png
findings.evidence: The buttons table lists the five footer column heads as buttons (21px tall, no fill); the capture clicked 'PRODUCT' at 1440 (trigger t4) and nothing opened.
findings.before: Column heads are buttons that do nothing at desktop width.
findings.after: Plain headings at desktop widths, and a disclosure button only where the columns collapse on a phone.
findings.why: Keyboard and screen-reader users meet five buttons in the footer that do nothing when pressed.

strengths: The cookie preferences dialog opens over a scrim with a close button, four labelled switches with 'Always on' on the required one, and closed after Escape (motion/t3-normal-600.png).
The FAQ uses one accordion row per question with a chevron, a single style for all six rows (tiles/1440-07.png).
The hero's product picture is labelled 'PRODUCT PREVIEW · SAMPLE DATA', so its tabs and status chips read as an illustration, not as controls (C48).
The stylesheet declares hover (169 rules), focus-visible (28), active (7), disabled (21), current or selected (32) and busy (3) states.
not_investigated: Sign-up, demo booking and login flows: the async capture found no primary action on the page to hold or fail.
Whether the header marks the current page past the home page: only the home page was captured; 'Home' has no current mark here.
What the phone menu holds and how it opens and closes: the capture opens triggers at 1440 only.
The FAQ disclosure: the capture clicked the first question but the still shows the top of the page, so its open state was not seen.
Inline validation and error placement: no fields.
Focus moving into the cookie dialog and back to its trigger, scroll lock and backdrop click; keyboard operation of custom widgets: lens-a11y.
Capture prep clicked 'Reject All' on the cookie banner at every width; the banner's first view is capture context, not judged here.
T-FIELD-READ, T-ERROR-PATH and T-TABLE-READ: no field, no failure run and no table outside the product picture.
